result.quote: Since he had much livestock in the foothills and in the plain, he built towers in the desert and dug many cisterns.
result.reason: The verse directly and uniquely gives his much livestock as the reason for both actions. His love of the soil instead explains why he had farmers and vinedressers. However, the edit changes the prepared question’s target from watchtowers and farming to both towers and cisterns and a livestock-based answer, so the original answer scope is not preserved.
